title: Two Moroccan Filmmakers Join the Oscars Academy — A Historic First for North Africa
body:
Two Moroccan film producers have received invitations to join the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, giving North Africa its first permanent voting representation at the Oscars. Academy membership grants full voting rights across all award categories.

Marrakech Film Festival Connection

Both producers have strong ties to the Marrakech International Film Festival (FIFM). Festival director Remi Bonhomme called it 'a recognition of everything Moroccan cinema has built over the past two decades.'

Source: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences announcement, via Kech24.
